findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:2 evidence command does not match intent. Intent requires: no-filter run, all 153 discovered smokes, summary `153/153 passed`. Evidence (CHK-001:happy:2) ran `node ... --tag fast` and noted `5/5 passed`. This is not equivalent—the no-filter full-suite coverage is entirely unverified by recorded evidence.

CHK-001:edge:0 evidence command does not cover the intent. Intent: `--select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT -> exits 0, summary shows 0/0 passed` (empty result set must not crash). Evidence command ran `--select gitroot` which finds real smokes and exits 0—it does not exercise the zero-match empty-set path at all. Re-run confirms `--select ZZZZZ_NONEXISTENT` does exit 0 with 0 smokes, but this was never recorded as evidence.

CHK-001:happy:1 / CHK-001:edge:3 / CHK-002 fast-tag evidence tainted: smoke-manifest.json assigns tag `fast` to `gap-log`, but gap-log-smoke exits 1 on HEAD (assertion mismatch: handler emits `Same gap already exists`, smoke asserts `/identical gap already exists/`). All evidence entries that ran `--tag fast` and claimed `pass` are invalidated for their fast-tag coverage. The gap-log preexisting failure is not introduced by this story, but recording `--tag fast` runs as passing evidence is incorrect. Re-run of `node ... --tag fast` confirms 3/4 passed, exit 1.

CHK-002:edge:0 evidence does not execute the intent. Intent: add a temp entry `{name:skip-me,skip:true}` to the real manifest and confirm skip-me does not appear in runner output. Evidence ran `node ... run-all-smokes-smoke.js` (self-smoke fixture level), which tests skip behavior with internal fixture data, not the actual smoke-manifest.json skip path. The skip flag in the real manifest entry (e.g. `run-all-smokes-smoke.ts` check 8: fixture-skip) exercises the runner code path, but the intent specifically required a real-manifest-entry test.

CHK-002:edge:2 evidence command does not match intent. Intent: `node -e require(smoke-manifest.json).smokes.filter(s=>s.tags).forEach(s=>{if(!Array.isArray(s.tags))throw 1}); console.log(SCHEMA_OK)`. Evidence command: `grep -n timeoutMs packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js` — this only confirms timeoutMs appears in the compiled runner source, not that manifest tag fields are typed correctly as arrays. Re-run of intent command returns SCHEMA_OK but this was not recorded.

CHK-003:happy:2 evidence command does not match intent. Intent: `node -e const p=require(./packages/main/package.json); console.log(p.scripts[test:run-all-smokes-smoke])` confirming the npm script value. Evidence command: `test -f packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes.js` — this only checks the dist artifact exists, completely unrelated to the npm script wiring check. Re-run of intent command confirms script is present and prints `node dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js`.

CHK-003:adversarial:4 evidence command does not match intent. Intent: `env -i HOME=\$HOME PATH=\$PATH node packages/main/dist/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.js -> exits 0` (confirms standalone-runnable without ambient env). Evidence command: `npm --prefix packages/main run test:run-all-smokes-smoke` — npm inherits the full shell environment, which does not test the ambient-env isolation guarantee. Re-run of the intent command confirms exit 0.

run-all-smokes.ts:116-118 selectSmokes pushes manifest-only entries that are not in discovered[] without deduplication — if manifest contains two entries with the same name (neither on disk), both are pushed to `all` and the smoke runs twice. No guard against this at line 110 (byName map overwrites silently) or at line 116 (includes check only deduplicates against discovered, not against already-pushed manifest extras).

run-all-smokes.ts:61 SmokeResult.status union includes `SKIP` as a valid variant, but no code path in runOneSmoke (lines 131-181) ever returns status=SKIP. Skipped entries are pre-filtered by selectSmokes before reaching runOneSmoke. The SKIP branch is dead/unreachable and the ternary at line 205 also does not handle it, so any hypothetical SKIP leakthrough would be printed as FAIL.

CHK-001:happy:2 replacement evidence is factually incorrect. The new evidence command `node ... --select run-all-smokes-smoke` returns `0 smokes matched filters` and exits 0 — it does NOT run the self-smoke at all. The runner derives smoke names by stripping the `-smoke.js` suffix: run-all-smokes-smoke.js becomes name=`run-all-smokes`. The substring `run-all-smokes-smoke` does not match the name `run-all-smokes` (confirmed: `run-all-smokes`.includes(`run-all-smokes-smoke`) = false). The evidence note claims `PASS run-all-smokes-smoke confirmed` but no smoke was executed. The intent (full no-filter 153-smoke run) remains uncovered. Correct select pattern is `--select run-all-smokes`.

CHK-003:edge:0 intent is unsatisfiable as written AND evidence still does not match. The intent says `--select run-all-smokes-smoke -> exits 0 with exactly 1 PASS line for run-all-smokes-smoke`. However the runner names this smoke `run-all-smokes` (strips -smoke.js suffix from run-all-smokes-smoke.js), so `--select run-all-smokes-smoke` always returns 0 smokes. The correct command to dogfood the self-smoke is `--select run-all-smokes`. Additionally the recorded evidence command is still `node ... --select gitroot` — the intent requires running the self-smoke through its own runner, not running gitroot smokes.

CHK-001:happy:1 and CHK-001:edge:3 evidence notes are factually stale. Both reference `5 fast smokes from manifest` but after the F-003 fix removing gap-log from the manifest, `--tag fast` now returns 3/3. The evidence materialHash (9b262b08...) predates the manifest change. The commands exit 0 on current HEAD (3/3 confirmed by reviewer re-run), so the behavior is correct, but the recorded note count is wrong. Evidence should be re-recorded against the current materialHash with accurate counts.
